main_text.l: Ut quando Principi, Satrapæ, aut Ma-
est, admonetur tantùm ut promittat in
verbo Principis, aut in verbo honoris sui
Cui monitioni si admota pectori manu
respondeat tantùm se id polliceri, Jura-
mentum jam pro præstito & perac̈to ha-
betur. In hoc casu dico breviter, juratum
non minùs obligari in conscientiâ, ad fi-
deliter præstandum ea quæ sic pollicitus
est, quàm si singula verba & syllabas ipse
titutum erat, ut hac prælectione comp-
lesterer & ea quæ ad Internam formam
pertinent. Sed continet ea pars dubia quædam

page.notes: The small marks under the last line (near the catchword) are probably a signature or printer's marks; they are not transcribed. The marginal note "Cafus41" may be read as "Casus 41". The ct ligature in "tactu", "præleƈtis" and "perac̈to" is rendered as ct. The line-end hyphen in "ha-betur" is printed. Long s has been set as plain s.
